name: Misha (Miša)

origin.note: Misha's feet; the mower is the right half of the frame

platforms.name: head
platforms.onLand: play bonk, bounce the kid up (vy -380px/s)

blades.note: a toy on the ground inside this box is mowed: remove it, play fx_toy_shredded centred on it, +1 mowed

behavior: mows back and forth across the lawn. At the end of the lawn (or a solid tile) play turn, flip, continue. Touching a hurtbox from the side or below costs the kid a life. Landing on a platform from above is safe; landing on the head plays bonk and Misha pauses 0.8s.

level.onWin: Misha joins as a playable hero (sprites/heroes/kids/misha)
level.endLine: Good job! Don't leave those toys out again!

mow.notes: walks behind the mower at about 45px/s; mower shakes, grass flies

turn.notes: pulls the mower around; ends facing LEFT (frame 3 = mirrored mow frame 0): flip the sprite and carry on with mow

bonk.notes: a kid landed on his head: squash, wobble, stars; hold the last frame ~0.4s, then mow
